en.answer:
No, it cannot be applied.

Since Special Summoning by this method is not considered a Fusion Summon, neither of the『substitute for any 1 Fusion Material whose name is mentioned on the Fusion Monster Card』effects of <<6044>>, <<4264>>, <<14531>>, <<4115>>, <<4275>>, <<4648>>, <<6256>>, <<6257>>, <<6258>> or <<12744>> can be applied.

Note that if you activate <<4837>> to Fusion Summon <<12252>>, you can apply the effect of <<6044>> (etc.). (You perform the Fusion Summon using 1 <<6044>> and 1 <<4007>>.)
